oil.when: 2020–2022 (Oil Control System in the display Settings > Maintenance menu)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Stop the car, set the parking brake and switch the ignition to ON.
Use the arrow buttons on the left of the steering wheel to reach Settings in the display between the gauges.
Select Oil Control System, press OK, then follow the reset instructions shown at the bottom of the screen.
If you use the Oil Filter or Oil and Filter reminder, open it and reset it as well.
oil.note: The Oil Control System sets its own interval, which you cannot change. A factory reset of the display also resets it, so only do that right after an oil change. Checked in the 2020 and 2022 owner's manuals.

tpms.when: 2020–2022 (no reset button or calibrate menu; clears after driving)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Drive above 16 mph (25 km/h). The light does not go out right after you add air; it goes out once the system re-reads the tires while driving.
If the light stays on after a few miles, recheck all four pressures with a gauge.
tpms.note: If the light flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the system has a fault or a wheel without a sensor (such as the spare) is fitted. A reset will not clear it; have it checked. Checked in the 2020 and 2022 owner's manuals.
